\index{add\_conn\_req() (in module model.gio\_db)@\spxentry{add\_conn\_req()}\spxextra{in module model.gio\_db}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{index:model.gio_db.add_conn_req}}\pysiglinewithargsret{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{model.gio\_db.}}\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{add\_conn\_req}}}{\emph{\DUrole{n}{idv}}, \emph{\DUrole{n}{signalv}}, \emph{\DUrole{n}{pairingv}}, \emph{\DUrole{n}{radio\_id}}}{}~\begin{itemize}
\item {} \begin{description}
\item[{if there is no connection request or a plant with id equal to the idv parameter:}] \leavevmode
it adds the connection request and returns the value True.

\end{description}

\item {} \begin{description}
\item[{If the connection request with idv was already present:}] \leavevmode
controls the signal strength of both requests (new and old).
If the signal strength of the new request is greater,
it replaces the old one with the new one and sends the refusal
operation to the radio of the old connection request,
otherwise only the pairing number changes.
In both cases the function returns the value True.

\end{description}

\item {} \begin{description}
\item[{If there was already a plant with id equal to idv (parameter):}] \leavevmode
send the join request to the associated radio:
if this request is not successful, the plant is deleted
and the new connection request is inserted, otherwise it does nothing.
In this case the function returns the value False.

\end{description}

\end{itemize}
\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\item[{Parameters}] \leavevmode\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{idv}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{string}}) \textendash{} vase serial number

\item {} 
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{signalv}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{int}}) \textendash{} the value of the request’s signal.

\item {} 
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{pairingv}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{int}}) \textendash{} three\sphinxhyphen{}digit random integer

\item {} 
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{radio\_id}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{string}}) \textendash{} radio serial number

\end{itemize}

\item[{Returns}] \leavevmode
True \sphinxhyphen{} if there was no connection request with id equal to idv,
or if it was present, but it has been replaced
because the signal of the new request is stronger.
False \sphinxhyphen{} if a plant with id equal to idv was present
and cannot communicate with the associated radio.

\item[{Return type}] \leavevmode
boolean

\end{description}\end{quote}

\end{fulllineitems}
